text:
lia: FYI we finished a small canary for the compact-batcher + encode-shrink change on the ded pool. summary below, looks promising. :rocket:

oscar: curious  TL;DR?

lia: TL;DR: median latency -22%, p95 -6%, p99 stable, token cost -31% on gen-heavy tests. stable under mixed load.

kevin: bench paste? include perf flags pls.

lia: bench output (pool: gd-dedicated-small, model: rw-13b-econ):

```
COMPACT-BATCHER CANARY - 2026-03-22 14:05 UTC
Model: rw-13b-econ
Profile: 70% generation, 30% chat
Baseline: p50=120ms, p95=360ms, p99=520ms, tokens/s=760, cost=$0.024/1k
Canary (compact+encode-shrink): p50=94ms, p95=338ms, p99=518ms, tokens/s=980, cost=$0.0166/1k
Delta: p50 -21.7%, p95 -6.1%, throughput +29%, unit-cost -30.8%
Notes: memory footprint reduced ~35% on gpu, fewer OOMs during spikes.
```

oscar: impressive throughput gain. any increase in tail CPU or jitter?

lia: p99 steady; small jitter around p95 during 10-15s burst tests but within SLO. decode CPU rose ~8% for short requests, 18% for >3k sequences. plan to gate encode-shrink for seq_len>3000.

build-bot: canary health check: errors=0.12% (down from 0.18%), mem=OK, disk I/O steady.

zara: rollout suggestion? risk windows?

lia: plan: expand canary to 30% tonight, run 4h stability pass, if green bump to 75% tomorrow morning. runtime flags: compact_batcher.enabled=true, encode_shrink.mode=aggressive, seq_gate=3000.

ops-bot: created ticket INF-4910 "Console: show projected cost savings for compact-batcher" assigned to kevin. https://rwinf.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4910

kevin: will add a quick card on the model page (1 day). also check dedicated pricing forecasts before GA.

oscar: what's rollback look like?

lia: rollback via feature-flip svc or console toggle: set compact_batcher.enabled=false for pool. quick curl: 

```
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/internal/featureflip \\ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \\ 
  -d '{"pool":"gd-dedicated-small","feature":"compact_batcher.enabled","value":false}'
```

zara: can we emit an alert for unexpected p95 regressions post-rollout? 10min window.

lia: will add alert + dashboard panel. dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/canaries/compact-batcher-2929999999

oscar: great outcome. if GA goes well let's include a blurb for the next customer newsletter highlighting the cost savings. :tada:

lia: agreed  will draft a one-paragraph note for marketing and an internal summary for sales.

kevin: thumbs from ops. nice job team.

lia: thanks all. short, measurable, low-risk rollout path.
